# Google Gen AI SDK    Stay organized with collections      Save and categorize content based on your preferences.
### Install
```
pip install --upgrade google-genai
```

### Quickstart
```
from google import genai
from google.genai.types import HttpOptions

client = genai.Client(http_options=HttpOptions(api_version="v1"))
response = client.models.generate_content(
    model="gemini-3.5-flash",
    contents="How does AI work?",
)
print(response.text)
# Example response:
# Okay, let's break down how AI works. It's a broad field, so I'll focus on the ...
#
# Here's a simplified overview:
# ...
```

web.description:
# Google Gen AI SDK [¶](https://googleapis.github.io/python-genai/#google-gen-ai-sdk)
## Installation [¶](https://googleapis.github.io/python-genai/#installation)
```
pip install google-genai
```

```
uv pip install google-genai
```

## Imports [¶](https://googleapis.github.io/python-genai/#imports)
```
from google import genai
from google.genai import types
```

## Create a client [¶](https://googleapis.github.io/python-genai/#create-a-client)
```
export GEMINI_API_KEY='your-api-key'
```

```
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()
```

### API Selection [¶](https://googleapis.github.io/python-genai/#api-selection)
```
from google import genai
from google.genai import types

client = genai.Client(
    enterprise=True,
    project='your-project-id',
    location='us-central1',
    http_options=types.HttpOptions(api_version='v1')
)
```
